run_inference_cli: run the vLLM inference script with a model name and user prompt via fire CLI
load_model_async_engine: load a vLLM AsyncLLMEngine model with optional LoRA support and parallelism settings
run_inference_with_lora: run LLM inference with a PEFT LoRA model using the vLLM async engine
run_inference_with_sampling: run LLM inference with custom top_p and temperature sampling parameters
run_inference_parallel: run LLM inference with pipeline and tensor parallelism across multiple GPUs
